items.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
items.blurb: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically.

items.title: Presentation: How To Run on Three Clouds at Once, and When Not To

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
